comment: Skin rarity modeled on the reference collection's tiers: two dominant neutrals (White slightly > Black) then a sharp drop to the rare Alien special. Weights are ~= target percent of the mint (they are normalised, so any positive scale works). Matched by case-insensitive substring of the skin filename; 'default' applies to an untagged skin. Fluorescent Cyan and Gold Foil were retired from the set; the remaining three keep their original ratio, rescaled to sum to 100.
